## New problem statement (complete when applicable)

- Established problem or newly formulated conjecture:
- Original proposer, primary source and verified URL:

  proposer and unestablished novelty/open-status disclosure:
- Identity review/allocation approval; registry, statement and display-order/ranking changes:

## Validation

- Changed-submission validator command/base and result:
- Python tests, JavaScript tests and site build commands/results:
- Rendered statement, references, attempts and downloadable sources inspected:

## Acknowledgments

- [ ] A successful build or formatting check is not mathematical proof verification.
- [ ] An LLM self-assessment or model-assisted check is not independent human verification.
- [ ] Any solved claim addresses the entire original target, not only a variant or special case.
- [ ] Model identities and human mathematical contributions/checking are disclosed accurately.
- [ ] Canonical IDs, existing source meaning, links and historical attribution are preserved.
- [ ] Source status and community review have not been substituted for an LLM claim.
